notes.title: New Maths Game Alert
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support for Madu Maths. It was my first ever game that I started developing way back during my studies and I am glad so many people (and so many kids especially) enjoyed playing my game. It made me smile reading your discussions and reviews. I hope it was both fun and educational.

I am here to announce that I have come back with my new game, Revel. Revel is a card game like blackjack or poker and it is mathematically unsolved, so it is perfect for those who want to exercise their muscles of odds and probability calculation. 

As you can guess, it involves simulated gambling, therefore it is more targeted at grown-ups, sorry little ones. So for the not-so-young-but-young-at-heart who had a ball with Madu Maths, Revel is a new frontier for you to tackle, with new challenges and achievements awaiting you. I know you'll love it.

Here it is on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1446050/Revel/

Can't wait for you to try!

- Tzar Leonardi
